Every form opens here and stays loaded while you work, so you can move between them without losing anything. Enter the student's details in the bar above once and they go into each form as you open it.

Your work stays in this window, and Autosave keeps a safety copy in this browser. Save case keeps everything in one file, and the master print gathers whichever forms you tick into one document.
